name: 5th Luna
source:
Hero finally graduated from the university, but his girlfriend decided not to wait for him and was dating another man already.

While walking the streets in frustration he was dragged into a suspicious shop and appeared in another solar system. He was recruited as a pilot to save that Arlheim planet.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公终于大学毕业了，但他的女朋友决定不再等他，已经开始和另一个男人交往了。在沮丧地走在街上时，他被拖进了一家可疑的商店，出现在了另一个星系中。他被招募为飞行员，去拯救那颗名为阿尔海姆的星球。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
